sections.text_helper: Section 22.2 "DAC main features" in chapter 22 (Digital-to-analog converter (DAC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 672.
sections.section_content:
The DAC main features are the following (see Figure142: Dual-channel DAC block
diagram):
• One DAC interface, maximum two output channels
• Left or right data alignment in 12-bit mode
• Synchronized update capability
• Noise-wave and Triangular-wave generation
• Dual DAC channel for independent or simultaneous conversions
• DMA capability for each channel including DMA underrun error detection
• Double data DMA capability to reduce the bus activity
• External triggers for conversion
• DAC output channel buffered/unbuffered modes
• Buffer offset calibration
• Each DAC output can be disconnected from the DACx_OUTy output pin
• DAC output connection to on-chip peripherals
• Sample and hold mode for low power operation in Stop mode
• Input voltage reference from VREF+ pin
Figure142 shows the block diagram of a DAC channel and Table156 gives the pin
description.
